name: Summer For You
source:
Summer For You is a spicy 2d visual novel with lots of mechanics where you’ll have to win the hearts of stunning girls! Build your harem or find your soulmate, save your soul or go straight to Hell with a demoness!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066980]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Summer For You》是一部辛辣的2D视觉小说，其中有很多机制，你必须赢得漂亮女孩的心！建立你的后宫或寻找你的灵魂伴侣，拯救你的灵魂或直接与恶魔一起下地狱！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066980]Steam[/url]]
